name: agent-engineering
description: Cross-cutting skills for disciplined AI-assisted development based on the 10 Claude Code Principles (Forsythe). Includes agent-prompt diagnosis, four-section restatement of end-of-work reports (done / pending / blocking / next), cross-cutting architectural decision capture, codebase architecture surveys (deep-module candidates), development-cycle retrospectives, a simplicity challenge that cuts a proposal down to tiers before it is built, a worth-building check that asks whether the work should be built as planned at all (the cheapest test that could kill the idea, and whether it comes first), OWASP AI-agent security review (standalone + wired into the SDD flow), git-worktree support for BB IDE (repo provisioning setup + merge-back handoff), a one-time tracing-foundation setup for applications (OpenTelemetry, sending to Opik or Langfuse), and self-contained SDD flow orchestration (no SDD plugin required) with a human design gate, tiered delivery, and — in an application that has the tracing foundation — a check of each feature's planned calls against a real run.
